question: Measure a keyless POST https://api.spider.cloud/scrape with the JSON body {"url": "https://example.com", "return_format": "markdown"} several times in one minute: status, bytes, whether the body holds page content, RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset, the 429 answer, and how many calls pass in a minute against free_rpm 4 (8 of 12 parallel keyless GETs passed in one minute).
why: scripts/probe/probe.py sends only GET and HEAD and broker.sh fetch sends only GET and HEAD, so no lane command can send a POST with a body. A keyless GET answers 400 with no page content and reaches the same free tier limiter (429, free_rpm 4), so it cannot show whether the POST returns content or counts against the same limit. Needs a probe tool with a method and a body option, then a unit whose Start from names the POST probe records for a lane to register.
